A clean, crisp digital gouache illustration for a video game background, looking down at about forty degrees on an alpine meadow with a granite cliff band, inspired by the North Cascades. A narrow mountain stream winds through the green meadow, a clear blue ribbon a few strides wide with a dark shadow under one bank, short pale ripple marks and a few sparkles. Where it reaches the lip of the grey granite cliff it falls over it as a waterfall of separate white strands with blue showing between them, the strands lit on their left by sun from the upper left. At the foot of the cliff the water lands in white spray and a small round pool, then winds on through the meadow below with a few white riffles where it runs over rocks. Wildflowers and a few conifers. No buildings, no people, no bridges.
